modelBrowser.costHelpBody: These numbers are measured, not promised. We look at every real reply on a model over the last 7 days: “typically” is the middle reply, “up to” is what 9 out of 10 replies stay under. Your own cost depends mostly on how much the model reads each turn — the chat so far plus the world's text — so long chats cost more and short ones less. Inside a chat the estimate is scaled to that chat's current size. Cached context and shorter replies bring it down.
modelBrowser.referenceCostBasis: Estimates: 21.3K input + 700 output tokens, no cache. Lunaris: 6K input. Reasoning adds cost.
modelBrowser.popularityInfoBody: 50% OpenRouter entertainment Token share + 50% Yumina Token share. Both compare the available chat models. Yumina counts official chat replies, excluding private APIs, background tasks and empty replies. Missing measurements contribute no score.
